description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development coordination with comprehensive infection prevention strategies, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and staff. You will play a crucial part in maintaining a healthy and compliant environment.

In this dynamic position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing staff education programs, conducting competency assessments, and overseeing all aspects of infection control. Your expertise will guide our team in best practices, regulatory compliance, and continuous quality improvement initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact within a supportive and professional setting.

If you are a proactive and experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for education and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and resident well-being.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations (e.g., CMS, CDC)
Strong communication, organizational, and teaching skills

description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a recently acquired facility, offering significant potential for growth and impact. The ideal candidate will be a driven and results-oriented professional ready to make a substantial contribution to our team.

This full-time position requires a professional and presentable individual who is prepared for occasional weekend work. We are committed to attracting top talent and offer competitive compensation for the right candidate who can demonstrate a strong track record of success in marketing and census development.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably in a skilled nursing or healthcare environment
Highly driven, results-oriented, and able to work independently
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide essential therapy services on a flexible, as-needed basis, making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This position comes with a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, reflecting the critical nature of the role and your valuable expertise. We are also pleased to offer a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to qualified candidates. If you are a compassionate and skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
